recorded.prompt:q-grid:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grid:a: 'So it is a step function: flat stretches, then a jump.'
recorded.prompt:q-grid:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grid:b: 'cannot say whether that came as one jump or ten'. The page's example gap held four steps.
recorded.prompt:q-grid:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-grid:c: The grid 'cannot say... at which budgets'. In the page's example, steps came inside the gap (38,090, 38,110...).
recorded.prompt:q-next:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-next:a: The height is V(K(v+1)), 'which can be more than v + 1: the plan that reaches the level most cheaply need not be the best plan'.
recorded.prompt:q-next:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-next:c: K(v+1) is 'the smallest budget at which some plan is worth more', so V does not step below 7,320.
recorded.prompt:q-next:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-next:d: The step is at K(v+1) exactly ('the step is at 38,260 exactly'), and its height is V(K(v+1)), not 641.
recorded.prompt:q-eff:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-eff:a: "So the best plan at a step costs exactly B"
recorded.prompt:q-eff:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-eff:b: Best plan at a step "costs exactly B"; a cheaper best plan means the step's budget is wrong, not unused budget.
recorded.prompt:q-eff:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-eff:d: "nothing in it fixes the plan's value"; the error is the step's budget, not the value.
